question: Can I pay Flowstone Flood's buyback cost when I have no cards in my hand to discard at random?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you cannot pay the buyback cost unless you have at least one card in your hand to discard.
expected.answer: You can’t pay the Buyback cost unless you have at least one card in your hand to discard.
